must.title: Data Security
must.description: Ensure all data is securely handled and stored.
must.metric: All sensitive data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
acceptance_criteria: Data encryption standards are applied to all sensitive information.
Security audits show no vulnerabilities in data handling.
Access to sensitive data is logged and monitored.

should.title: System Performance
should.description: Ensure the system performs efficiently under expected load.
should.metric: System response time under load should not exceed 2 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: System response time is consistently under 2 seconds during peak load.
Load tests simulate 10x expected peak load without performance degradation.
Performance metrics are monitored and reported in real-time.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99.

should.title: System Availability
should.description: Ensure high availability of the system.
should.metric: System uptime should be 99.9% or higher.
acceptance_criteria: System uptime is consistently 99.9% or higher.
Redundancy and failover mechanisms are in place and tested.
Downtime incidents are logged and analyzed for root cause.

should.title: User Experience
should.description: Ensure a positive user experience with intuitive interfaces.
should.metric: User satisfaction scores should be 85% or higher.
acceptance_criteria: User satisfaction surveys show scores of 85% or higher.
User feedback is regularly collected and analyzed for improvements.
UI/UX design follows best practices for accessibility and usability.

should.title: Scalability
should.description: Ensure the system can scale to accommodate future growth.
should.metric: System can handle a 50% increase in users without performance loss.
acceptance_criteria: Scalability tests show the system can handle a 50% increase in users.
Infrastructure supports horizontal scaling as needed.
Performance metrics remain stable under increased load.
should.verification: Scalability testing with simulated user growth.

executive_summary: The project aims to modernize the contractor management system by translating existing features to .NET and implementing enhancements from Phase 9 and 9.2, focusing on DTO auto-population and onboarding improvements.
